title: Publish immutable score processor image metadata
description: Update the score processor image build path so every image can be referenced by immutable tag or digest and downstream deployment pipelines can promote a precise image version.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Starting implementation in an isolated infrastructure/score_processor_artifacts CDK app. The app will leave the legacy infrastructure app and existing production pipeline untouched, publish score processor images with immutable git-SHA tags, resolve the ECR digest, and emit image metadata for downstream deployment owners.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Implemented the isolated score processor artifact publisher CDK app under infrastructure/score_processor_artifacts. It creates a retained ECR repository, CodePipeline V2 source/build flow, Docker-enabled CodeBuild project, immutable git-SHA image tagging, digest resolution, image-detail.json output, and generic /plexus/score-processor-artifacts metadata parameters. Validation passed: python -m pytest tests/unit -q; cdk synth. cdk diff was not run because the local AWS session is expired.
